method: BASELINE. scope: From the student's seat: the ABSTUDY student start-up loan (ss 7C, 7D, 7E as text; the qualification period, s 3(1); the qualification test day, s 7C(2)); when the loan becomes an ABSTUDY SSL debt or an overpayment (ss 8B, 38A, 39) and its amount (ss 8B(3), 8BA); the former accumulated ABSTUDY SSL debt (s 9B with s 9CA(1)); whether a compulsory repayment is due (ss 10F(1)(a), (b), (3), 12ZK; the amounts not covered); notifying a prescribed event (ss 48, 49); when an overpayment debt is due (ss 38, 39, 40, 41A(4)); interest charge (ss 41, 41C, 41D, 41E); waiver (ss 43B, 43D, 43E(1)-(4), 43F); departure prohibition orders and certificates (ss 43G, 43P); review (ss 302, 304, 311, 312, 308A, 308F, 308H, 12ZQ, 43U, 43X). Out: the ABSTUDY Scheme itself (Living Allowance, relocation, approved scholarship courses: facts); formulas lost in conversion (ss 9C(1), 9CA(2), 10F(1), 12ZLC(1), 43E(6)); Part 3 tax file numbers; assessments (ss 10H-10L) except as reviewable decisions; the Student Financial Supplement Scheme contracts (Part 4A Divisions 1-5); s 43C; recovery from third parties and financial institutions (ss 42, 42A); write-off (s 43); departure order notification and enforcement (ss 43J-43M, 43Q-43T, 43Y-43ZC); information gathering, confidentiality and machinery (Parts 1, 7, 8, 10). Added 2026-10-24 (saa-regulations.l4): the ABSTUDY prescribed events (regs 12-21) and reg 29 for s 48, with the s 48 duty as a regulative rule. Out: the AIC events (regs 22-28). Added 2026-10-24 (saa-formulas.l4), from C2004A00058.formulas.md: the accumulated ABSTUDY SSL debt (ss 9C, 9CA(2), 9D), the compulsory ABSTUDY SSL and FS repayment amounts (ss 10F, 10G, 12ZK, 12ZLB, 12ZLC, with HESA s 154-20(2) restated), and the s 43E(6) present value with s 43E(5)(b).
seat: the student: the ABSTUDY recipient who takes a student start-up loan, and the former student or recipient who owes a student debt
